item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00129","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C06","C25"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 is an unmistakable drafting template for the child memorandum. Both announce a national civil-defense test exercise, justify it through preparedness, vigilance, community participation, disaster mitigation, and deterrence, and then direct every executive department and agency at national and field levels to participate, cooperate with Federal, State, and local authorities, and authorize participating Federal employees' release under the April 22, 1954 directive. The child largely rewrites C03 while updating the exercise dates and participating jurisdictions. C06 supplies the underlying employee-release machinery, and C25 is an earlier, narrower exercise-participation memorandum, but neither matches the child's complete language and structure as closely as C03.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"On June 15 and 16, 1955, a national Civil Defense test exercise will be held.","parent_excerpt":"On June 14 and 15, 1954, a nation-wide Civil Defense test exercise will be held","explanation":"The child updates the dates and slightly revises the description of the same kind of exercise announcement."},{"child_excerpt":"Every community and every citizen must be ready to act swiftly... Not only will such vigilance and preparedness minimize the effects of any disaster, it can powerfully deter aggression itself.","parent_excerpt":"It means developing a preparedness, a vigilance, so impressive as to deter aggression itself. This awareness must touch every community, every citizen of our land.","explanation":"Both use the distinctive linked rationale of vigilance and preparedness, every community and citizen, limiting disaster damage, and deterring aggression."},{"child_excerpt":"Therefore, I hereby direct each department and agency of the Executive Branch of the Government, both at the national and field level: To cooperate fully with Federal, State and local civil defense authorities; to take part in this civil defense exercise","parent_excerpt":"Therefore, I hereby direct each department and agency of the Executive Branch of the Government, both at the national and field level, to take part in this civil defense exercise, to cooperate fully with Federal, State and local civil defense authorities","explanation":"This is nearly verbatim operative language, with only the order of the two commands reversed."},{"child_excerpt":"to the extent feasible under the terms of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], dated April 22, 1954, to authorize the release of Federal Employees who are enrolled in local civil defense organizations to perform such civil defense duties as are assigned during this exercise.","parent_excerpt":"to the extent feasible under the terms of Executive Order, dated April 22, 1954, to authorize the release of Federal employees who are enrolled in local civil defense organizations to perform such civil defense duties as are assigned during this exercise.","explanation":"The final operative clause is effectively identical and invokes the same underlying directive and administrative mechanism."}]}
